#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class IO {
private:
    static const int BUFSIZE = 1 << 15;
    char buf[BUFSIZE];
    int bufc;
    int bufi;
    stringstream sb;

    void fillBuf() {
        bufi = 0;
        bufc = 0;
        while (bufc == 0) {
            cin.read(buf, BUFSIZE);
            bufc = cin.gcount();
            if (bufc == 0) {
                bufc = 0;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    bool pumpBuf() {
        if (bufi == bufc) fillBuf();
        return bufc != 0;
    }

    bool isDelimiter(char c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f';
    }

    void eatDelimiters() {
        while (true) {
            if (bufi == bufc) {
                fillBuf();
                if (bufc == 0) throw runtime_error("IO: Out of input.");
            }
            if (!isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) break;
            ++bufi;
        }
    }

public:
    IO() : bufc(0), bufi(0) {}

    string next() {
        sb.str("");
        sb.clear();
        eatDelimiters();
        int start = bufi;
        while (true) {
            if (bufi == bufc) {
                sb.write(buf + start, bufi - start);
                fillBuf();
                start = 0;
                if (bufc == 0) break;
            }
            if (isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) break;
            ++bufi;
        }
        sb.write(buf + start, bufi - start);
        return sb.str();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        long long val = nextLong();
        if (val < INT_MIN || val > INT_MAX) throw runtime_error("IO.nextInt: Invalid int.");
        return (int)val;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        eatDelimiters();
        bool positive = true;
        if (buf[bufi] == '-') {
            ++bufi;
            if (!pumpBuf()) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
            positive = false;
        }
        long long ret = 0;
        bool first = true;
        while (true) {
            if (!pumpBuf()) break;
            if (isDelimiter(buf[bufi])) {
                if (first) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                break;
            }
            first = false;
            if (buf[bufi] >= '0' && buf[bufi] <= '9') {
                if (ret < -922337203685477580LL) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
                ret *= 10;
                ret -= (buf[bufi] - '0');
                if (ret > 0) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
            } else {
                throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
            }
            ++bufi;
        }
        if (positive) {
            if (ret == -9223372036854775808LL) throw runtime_error("IO.nextLong: Invalid long.");
            ret = -ret;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    void println() {
        cout << '\n';
    }

    template<typename T>
    void println(T t) {
        cout << t << '\n';
    }

    template<typename T>
    void print(T t) {
        cout << t;
    }

    void flush() {
        cout.flush();
    }
};

// Global IO object
IO io;

// Utility
long long min(long long a, long long b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
long long max(long long a, long long b) { return a > b ? a : b; }

long long brute1(long long m) {
    long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
    long long rem = m % 6;
    if (rem == 5) ans += 4;
    else if (rem == 4) ans += 2;
    return ans;
}

void solve() {
    long long n = io.nextLong();
    long long m = io.nextLong();
    if (m < n) {
        swap(m, n);
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        io.println(brute1(m));
        return;
    }
    if (n == 2) {
        if (m < 3) io.println(0);
        else if (m == 3) io.println(4);
        else if (m == 7) io.println(12);
        else io.println(2 * m);
        return;
    }
    // general case solution:
    io.println(2 * (n * m / 2));
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
